abort.already_configured: Renault Zoe New is already configured.

user.title: Zoe New Extended
user.description: Add extended controls, diagnostics, and smart charging support for Renault Zoe New.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Choose one language for all Renault ZOE dashboard pages and enable or disable the complete IMMAX module. Disabling IMMAX hides its tab and stops its automations.

smart_charging.title: Smart charging settings
smart_charging.description: Select the zones where smart charging may control the car and the Nord Pool price area used by the planner.

cost_model.title: Energy cost model
cost_model.description: Configure the values used for charge-session costs, battery inventory value, and fallback trip estimates.

data.elektrum_drive_enabled: Detect Elektrum Drive stations and tariffs

charging_accounts.title: Charging accounts
charging_accounts.description: Manage any number of Mobilly and Elektrum Drive accounts. Configured accounts: {account_count}. Transactions from all enabled accounts are merged without double-counting overlapping sessions.

mobilly_account.title: Mobilly account
mobilly_account.description: {mode} a Mobilly account. Both Transactions and Invoice transactions are synchronized. Leave the password empty while editing to keep the saved password.

elektrum_account.title: Elektrum Drive account
elektrum_account.description: {mode} an Elektrum Drive app account. Leave the access token and device ID empty while editing to keep their saved values. An account without a token is saved as awaiting authentication.

remove_charging_account.title: Remove charging account
remove_charging_account.description: Remove {account_name} and its saved authentication data? Historical HA states are not deleted.

immax_setpoints.title: IMMAX setpoints
immax_setpoints.description: Configure the IMMAX charging controller. These values are synchronized with the existing Home Assistant helpers after saving.

immax_entities.title: IMMAX entity sources
immax_entities.description: Select the Home Assistant entities used by the IMMAX controller. Charger control, current, and the site load meter are required; other measurement or status sources may be left empty and are then excluded. Calculated values remain read-only.

error.mobilly_credentials_required: Mobilly username and password are required.
error.soc_resume_must_exceed_stop: Battery SOC resume threshold must be higher than the stop threshold.
error.solar_max_must_reach_min: Maximum solar charging power must be at least the minimum power.
